name: tree-of-life
when_to_use: Example look (the TextureFlow smoke render): lush painterly tree-of-life in red, orange and deep blue, gentle outward concentric motion. Full-frame colour, so it washes a whole wall — best as a fill for one fabric or ceiling region.
notes: Seeded from the TextureFlow smoke test (Eden's reference args, seed 42, juggernaut, 384x384, no upscale) — not tuned for a venue yet. Draft settings: n_steps 4, upscales off; for a final drop the n_steps/upscale args or pass n_steps=8. The bright sky in the style images becomes lit background: on a dark wall consider darker style images.
